documentation.content: Runbook row: Job failure and missed schedule (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. Notifies on any non-succeeded chirp-media-reconcile execution in a 5-minute window. Slice 2 follow-up covers the missed-schedule half (conditionAbsent), out of scope here since no Cloud Scheduler cron/timezone/grace is checked in yet. The 5-minute evaluation window is a judgment call, not a runbook-stated number. Initial, review after 7 days.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.job_name="chirp-media-reconcile" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result!="succeeded"
